style: Palette of glossy lab white, graphite black and steel grey, with acid lime-green neon glow as the one bright accent.

images.prompt: Dynamic low-angle shot of a floating arena platform in a huge bright test hangar under stage spotlights. On the right, a boxy, clearly mechanical robot fighter with a square visor head, bolted graphite-black armor plates and glowing lime-green seams points a chunky toy-like energy blaster. Further right, a stocky steel-grey robot tumbles backward off the platform edge, a bright lime shockwave ring and a sparkle trail behind it. Floating platforms and crates around. The lower left of the picture is open stage floor and soft light.

Side view of a 2D platform fighter arena: several floating metal platforms over a deep glowing pit, wooden crates and glass panes as cover. A chunky humanoid robot in glossy graphite-black armor with glowing lime-green seams crouches behind a crate on the left, holding a chunky toy-like energy blaster. On a higher platform to the right, a stocky steel-grey robot pulls a glowing battery pack out of its own stubby blaster. Spare blasters lying on the platforms and a glowing supply box. Clean readable silhouettes.

Wide shot above the clouds: a stocky steel-grey humanoid robot flies away at enormous speed toward a distant bright horizon, its armor glowing and vibrating with lime-green energy lines, a long bright streak behind it. In the lower foreground, the edge of a floating arena platform where a huge lime shockwave ring is still expanding from the hit. The robot is small in the sky, like a shooting star.

Tall portrait cover: a heroic boxy, clearly mechanical robot fighter with a square visor head, bolted graphite-black armor plates and glowing lime-green seams stands in a confident pose on a floating arena platform, a chunky toy-like energy blaster resting on one shoulder and a big glowing hammer in the other hand. Bright stage spotlights and floating crates behind, a steel-grey robot tumbling away far off in the sky. Empty space at the top of the picture.

Wide view of an enormous bright research hangar: a white test facility with several floating arena stages suspended at different heights, spinning saw hazards and round bumpers on them, small robots fighting on the far stages. In the foreground, a glass control booth where engineers in white lab coats sit at consoles cheering, screens glowing lime green. Spotlights and gantries overhead.
